vendor_error_text: Failed to start a new task: filament loading/unloading not completed.
observation: The refusal came while the right nozzle was still at 232 °C from the red load, with nozzle and bed targets at zero. ams_status 0x300 and the right extruder stat 0x60300 persisted after it cooled, but H2C reports ams_status 0x300 and an extruder stat 0x30300 while printing normally, so neither flag marks an open load. The resend after the load cycle had ended, at 06:32Z with the nozzle at 41 °C, was accepted as task 1307189764.
